title: Newbie Protect
description: NewbieProtect is a lightweight, highly optimized, and multi-language plugin designed to shield new players from unwanted PvP during their first minutes on the server.
body:
# 🚀 Key Features
⏳ **Automatic Activation:** Protection triggers automatically the very first time a new player joins the server.

⏸️ **Smart Pause System:** Players can toggle their protection using /newbie-disable and /newbie-enable. Disabling it safely "pauses" and saves their remaining time, completely preventing any timer-reset exploits!

🚫 **One-Time Use Only:** Once the configured protection time (e.g., 15 minutes) hits zero, the player is permanently flagged and can never activate the protection again.

📊 **Two Display Modes:** Choose between a sleek BossBar (with a smoothly decreasing progress bar) or a clean Action Bar timer.

🎨 **Fully Customizable:** Easily change the BossBar color, style, duration, and all messages directly inside the configuration file.

🌍 **Multi-Language Support:** Out of the box localization for 6 languages: English (en), Russian (ru), German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), and Ukrainian (uk).

🔄 **On-The-Fly Reloading**: Update all settings, colors, and styles without restarting the server using a single command: /newbie reload.

# 💻 Compatibility & Supported Server Jars
Built using modern API standards and fully optimized for multi-threaded server environments:

Supported Minecraft Versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.x, 1.18.x, 1.19.x, 1.20.x, 1.21.x.

- Supported Server Software (Jars):

- Spigot (Classic base)

- Bukkit (The classic foundation - fully supported via native Bukkit API)

- Paper (Popular optimized software)

- Purpur (Advanced Paper fork)

- Folia (🔥 The revolutionary multi-threaded region-based software by PaperMC - this plugin is fully adapted to run smoothly on its asynchronous region schedulers!)
